svg.title: Separate native illumination and return fibers — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: One propagating fiber delivers 488 nm excitation to a fluorescent specimen. A physically separate fiber entry collects nearby emission and routes it through a long-pass filter to a detector. The setup uses scalar fiber coupling and qualitative isotropic specimen emission. It does not model a coherent image bundle, 3D collection solid angle or tissue-depth sensitivity.
